shortDescription: Create, modify and delete NFS, S3 or Azure offload targets

options.name: access_key
options.description: Access Key ID of the offload target

options.name: account
options.description: Name of the Azure blob storage account

options.name: address
options.description: The IP or FQDN address of the NFS server

options.name: api_token
options.description: FlashArray API token for admin privileged user.

options.name: auth_region
options.description: The region that will be used for initial authentication request. This parameter is optional and should be used only when region autodetection fails.

options.name: bucket
options.description: Name of the bucket for the S3 or GCP target

options.name: client_id
options.description: ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: container
options.description: Name of the blob container of the Azure target

options.name: context
options.description: Name of fleet member on which to perform the operation. This requires the array receiving the request is a member of a fleet and the context name to be a member of the same fleet.

options.name: disable_warnings
options.description: Disable insecure certificate warnings in debug logs

options.name: fa_url
options.description: FlashArray management IPv4 address or Hostname.

options.name: id_token
options.description: A pre-signed JWT to authenticate with, as an alternative to I(api_token). The token is exchanged by the array for a short-lived access token. Requires a matching API Client to be registered on the array (see M(everpure.flasharray.purefa_apiclient)).

options.name: initialize
options.description: Define whether to initialize the offload bucket

options.name: issuer
options.description: The API Client's trusted identity issuer registered on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: key_id
options.description: Key ID of the API Client that issues the identity token. Used with I(private_key_file).

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the offload target

options.name: options
options.description: Additional mount options for the NFS share Supported mount options include I(port), I(rsize), I(wsize), I(nfsvers), and I(tcp) or I(udp)

options.name: placement
options.description: AWS S3 placement strategy

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Path to the PEM RSA private key used to sign an identity token, as an alternative to I(api_token). Requires I(client_id), I(key_id), I(issuer) and I(username).

options.name: private_key_password
options.description: Password protecting I(private_key_file), if encrypted.

options.name: profile
options.description: The Offload target profile that will be selected for this target. This option allows more granular configuration for the target on top of the protocol parameter

options.name: protocol
options.description: Define which protocol the offload engine uses NFS is not a supported protocol from Purity//FA 6.6.0 and higher

options.name: secret
options.description: Secret Access Key for the offload target

options.name: share
options.description: NFS export on the NFS server

options.name: state
options.description: Define state of offload

options.name: uri
options.description: The URI used to create a connection between the array and a non-AWS S3 offload target. Storage placement strategies are not supported for non-AWS S3 offload targets. Both the HTTP and HTTPS protocols are allowed.

options.name: username
options.description: Username the issued token should be granted to. Must be a valid user on the array. Used with I(private_key_file).
